acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-batch-check prints the per-constituent reason code (unsupported-object-alternates) and a fix line
a test covers an alternates-backed clone
body: Observed 2026-10-19 on batch claude/batch-1019a (clone made with git clone --reference): `cem status` returns unsupported-object-alternates for every constituent, but dogfood-batch-check surfaces only `state=unsupported`, so the operator cannot tell the cause is the clone layout rather than the CEM. Expected: the batch check prints the underlying reason code and the fix (use git clone --no-local or repack -a and remove alternates).
title: dogfood-batch-check reports constituents in an alternates-backed clone only as state=unsupported, hiding unsupported-object-alternates
